chapter: Trio years, the Sands and Armstrong recollections
title: Fats Waller barely featured him
summary: He was not featured with Fats and was used to being free with Trent.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom

blocks.x: Now with Fats, did Fats feature you much in his band?

I didn't get a chance to do too much with Fats. I did some--they featured me some, but that's one of the reasons I didn't stay. I was so accustomed to being free with Trent, I was completely free there--
(Side B of Tape 4 ends at this point.)
